Where Ink Meets Imagination

I'm Fiona, an artist who finds magic in the interplay of ink, watercolor, and graphite. My work ranges from delicate architectural sketches to bold portraits and whimsical illustrations.

Each piece begins with a story - whether it's capturing the soul through hyper-realistic eyes, exploring fantastical characters, or painting sun-drenched doorways adorned with bougainvillea. I work primarily in traditional media, believing that the texture of paper and the flow of ink create a connection that digital can't replicate.

From detailed graphite portraits to vibrant watercolor landscapes, from dark gothic illustrations to playful character studies - my portfolio reflects a curiosity for diverse subjects and an endless fascination with the human form and the world around us.
